core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness ME12
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness ME12 requiring modernisation, with no onward chain. The property offers gas central heating and mains services.

The ground floor comprises a reception room. The first floor provides two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available without the need for a permit.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness.

For sale by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. A non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT is payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price. Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. The property is offered with no onward chain. Construction is standard. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains. Heating is gas central heating. Broadband is FTTC and mobile signal has good outdoor coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining issues are none known.
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Mid-terrace house requiring modernisation in Sheerness with gas central heating, rear yard and no onward chain. Guide Price £150,000, freehold, Council Tax Band A, EPC E.
keyFeatures: For sale by Modern Method of Auction with 56-day reservation period
